'''Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri''' (21 July 1947 – 13 December 2024) was an Indian inorganic chemist and a vice-chancellor of [[Tezpur University]].<ref name="Vice-Chancellor, Tezpur University">{{Cite web |url=http://www.tezu.ernet.in/vision/det_vc_mkc.htm |title=Vice-Chancellor, Tezpur University |date=2016 |publisher=Tezpur University |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130308062414/http://www.tezu.ernet.in/vision/det_vc_mkc.htm |archive-date=8 March 2013}}</ref> He is known for his studies on the synthesis of dioxygen complexes and fluorine compounds of metals and non metals<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=422 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2016 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> and was an elected fellow of the [[Indian National Science Academy]],<ref name="Indian fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=N91-1074 |title=Indian fellow |date=2016 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy}}</ref> and the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Chaudhuri,_Prof._Mihir_Kanti |title=Fellow profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 1989, for his contributions to chemical sciences.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{cite web | url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx | title=View Bhatnagar Awardees | publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize | date=2016 | access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref>

== Biography ==
[[File:MainView.png|thumb|235px|Tezpur University]]
M. K. Chaudhuri, born on 21 July 1947 in the northeast Indian state of [[Assam]], obtained a master's degree from [[Kalyani University]] before securing his PhD from the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur]] in 1973.<ref name="Indian fellow" /> Moving to Germany, he completed Dr rer. net. from [[Ruhr University Bochum]] in 1975 and returned to India to join the [[North Eastern Hill University]] as a professor at the department of chemistry. Later, he moved to the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Guwahati]] as the head of the chemistry department where he served as the dean of student affairs as well as the dean of research and development.<ref name="An Interview with the Vice-Chancellor of Tezpur University, Prof. Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri">{{Cite web |url=http://gonitsora.com/interview-vice-chancellor-tezpur-university-prof-mihir-kanti-chaudhuri/ |title=An Interview with the Vice-Chancellor of Tezpur University, Prof. Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri |date=11 April 2016 |publisher=Gonit Sora}}</ref> In May 2007, he was appointed the vice chancellor of Tezpur University. On completion of his five-year term, he was reappointed the vice-chancellor in 2012<ref name="Ajit Singh, C.J.">{{Cite web |url=http://ghconline.gov.in/Judgment/WPC63522012.pdf |title=Ajit Singh, C.J. |date=2016 |publisher=Government of India}}</ref> and held the position until May 2017.{{cn|date=July 2026}}

Chaudhuri's researches have been focused on the synthesis of [[Dioxygen|dioxygen complexes]] and fluorine compounds of metals and non-metals.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{cite web | url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners | publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research | date=1999 | access-date=5 October 2016 | pages=34 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf | archive-date=4 March 2016 | url-status=dead }}</ref> He has published a number of articles in peer-reviewed journals{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and Indian Academy of Sciences have listed 88 of them in their online repository.<ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Chaudhuri=3AMihir_Kanti=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref> Under his leadership, Tezpur University have developed into a major centre of learning in India and received the ''Visitor's Award for the Best University'' from the President of India in 2016.<ref name="TU V-C receives Visitor’s Best University award">{{Cite web |url=http://www.assamtribune.com/scripts/detailsnew.asp?id=mar1816/state056 |title=TU V-C receives Visitor's Best University award |date=17 March 2016 |publisher=Assam Tribune}}</ref> He has been associated with the Department of Science and Technology, Council of Scientific and Industrial Research and the [[University Grants Commission of India]] as well as the state and union government bodies as an expert committee member and has organized many refresher courses and seminars at the university and outside.<ref name="Course director">{{Cite web |url=http://web-japps.ias.ac.in:8080/SEP/Reports/report_rc/82_2010_3%20(2).pdf |title=Course director |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences}}</ref><ref name="Brain drain a major problem: Prof Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri">{{Cite web |url=http://htsyndication.com/htsportal/article/Brain-drain-a-major-problem%3A-Prof-Mihir-Kanti-Chaudhuri/13290920 |title=Brain drain a major problem: Prof Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri |date=23 May 2016 |publisher=HT Syndication}}</ref> He was also a member of the Indo-US Higher Education Dialogue of 2014<ref name="Indo-US Higher Education Dialogue">{{Cite web |url=http://www.going-global-edu.in/all-pdfs/listofmembers.pdf |title=Indo-US Higher Education Dialogue |date=2016 |publisher=Global Education |access-date=23 November 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161123201455/http://www.going-global-edu.in/all-pdfs/listofmembers.pdf |archive-date=23 November 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref> and the Inspire program on Mathematics of the Department of Science and Technology.<ref name="Inspire program on Mathematics">{{Cite web |url=http://www.inspire-dst.gov.in/List_of_Chairpersons_Members.pdf |title=Inspire program on Mathematics |date=2016 |publisher=Inspire}}</ref>

Chaudhuri died on 13 December 2024, at the age of 77.<ref>[https://www.indiatodayne.in/assam/story/renowned-chemist-and-former-tezpur-university-vice-chancellor-dr-mihir-kanti-chaudhuri-passes-away-1137079-2024-12-13 Renowned chemist and former Tezpur University vice-chancellor Dr Mihir Kanti Chaudhuri passes away]</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
The Indian Academy of Sciences elected him as their fellow in 1988<ref name="Fellow profile" /> and the [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]] awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards, in 1989.<ref name="Chemical Sciences">{{cite web|url=http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm |title=Chemical Sciences |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research |date=2016 |access-date=7 November 2016 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120912012851/http://www.csir.res.in/external/heads/career/award/BPRIZE/CHEMICAL_SCIENCES.htm |archive-date=12 September 2012 }}</ref> He became an elected fellow of the Indian National Science Academy in 1991 and received P. Natrajan Endowment Award in 1998. He is also a recipient of the Chemito Award (2002) and S. S. Sandhu Award of [[Indian Chemical Society]] (2005).<ref name="Indian fellow" /> In 2017 he received honorary [[D.Sc]] degree from [[Kalyani University]] and [[University of Science and Technology, Meghalaya]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ndtv.com/education/kalyani-university-conferss-honorary-d-litt-to-cricketer-jhulan-goswami-ustad-rashid-khan-poet-joy-g-1747310|title = Kalyani University Confers Honorary D.Litt. To Cricketer Jhulan Goswami, Ustad Rashid Khan, Poet Joy Goswami}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.theshillongtimes.com/2017/06/11/ustm-confers-honorary-d-litt-degree-on-lapang/|title = USTM confers Honorary D.Litt degree on Lapang|date = 11 June 2017}}</ref>
